_comment: CTA background images per blog. Image paths are RELATIVE — the blog's own domain (wp_url) is prepended automatically, so staging vs production resolves itself. To manage images: edit a category path below, add a new category key, or add a blog-slug section to override the defaults for one blog. 'default' (top level) is the fallback set used by any blog without its own section. The 'default' category inside a set is used when no category matches. Blog slugs in 'disabled' get NO cta-section-modern banner — the inline CTA in the generated article is used instead.
